issues.explanation: In 古今多少事, this means “many/how many,” not merely “number.”
The local word is simply “snake”; the variant-character gloss is unusable here.
干政 is a lexicalized word meaning interference in government; splitting it hides that useful word.
issues.suggested_fix: Segment 干政 as one word: “to interfere in government affairs.”

issues.explanation: This denotes the group of Ten Permanent Attendants, not a byword for corruption.
人 and the personal name 张角 are incorrectly combined, hiding the name.
In 进山, 山 means “mountain,” not the surname Shan.
南华老仙 is a conventional character designation/title; splitting off 老仙 obscures it.
issues.suggested_fix: Keep 南华老仙 together as a name/title.

issues.explanation: In 三卷, 三 is the numeral “three,” not surname San.
In 大贤良师, 师 means “teacher” as part of Zhang Jue’s title, not a surname.
issues.suggested_fix: Mark as a word and gloss “teacher,” or annotate the full title 大贤良师.

issues.explanation: In 立三十六方, 立 means “to establish/set up,” not surname Li.
Here 派 means “to send/dispatch”; the unrelated 派司 dictionary reference is misleading.
In 分路, 路 means “route,” not surname Lu.
In 在幽州, 在 is the locative “in/at,” not “to exist.”
In 家贫, 家 means “family/household,” not the unrelated dialect senses shown.
This is an ordinary descriptive phrase meaning that the hands reach past the knees, not a lexicalized idiom.
issues.suggested_fix: Mark as a word or split as 过 + 膝; gloss “reach past the knees.”

issues.explanation: In 从郑玄、卢植求学, 从 means “from; under the instruction of,” not merely a variant-character reference.
看榜 means “read/look at the notice,” not “look after.”
In 三人, 三 is the numeral “three,” not surname San.
In 救国, 国 means “country,” not surname Guo.
In 安民, 安 means “to pacify/bring peace to,” not surname An.
issues.suggested_fix: Gloss as “to pacify; bring peace to.”

issues.explanation: Here 匹 is the classifier for horses, not “matching.”
In 五百两金银, 两 is the unit “tael/liang,” not the numeral “two.”
In 三人, 三 is the numeral “three,” not surname San.
In 投在刘焉麾下, 在 expresses being under/within someone’s command, not existence.
In 五万人, 万 is the numeral “ten thousand,” not a reference to 万俟.
关羽 is a personal name and must not be split into surname Guan plus feather.
issues.suggested_fix: Keep 关羽 together as the name Guan Yu.

issues.explanation: In 五百人, 百 is the numeral “hundred,” not surname Bai.
关羽 is incorrectly split here, causing 羽 to be treated as “feather.”
issues.suggested_fix: Keep 关羽 together as the name Guan Yu.

issues.explanation: 关羽 is incorrectly split here, hiding the personal name.
issues.suggested_fix: Keep 关羽 together as the name Guan Yu.

issues.explanation: In 再令关羽…, 令 means “to order/command,” not the unrelated dictionary reference.
关羽 is incorrectly split here, hiding the personal name.
issues.suggested_fix: Keep 关羽 together as the name Guan Yu.

issues.explanation: In 山左右, 山 means “mountain,” not surname Shan.
In 两翼, 翼 means “wing/flank,” not the surname Yi.
issues.suggested_fix: Mark as a word and gloss “wing; flank.”

issues.explanation: In 五百人, 百 is the numeral “hundred,” not surname Bai.
This incorrectly creates a single phrase; the context is 大风 plus 火攻.
issues.suggested_fix: Split as 大风 (“strong wind”) + 火攻 (“to attack with fire”).

issues.explanation: The personal name 曹腾 is hidden inside a larger phrase.
issues.suggested_fix: Split as 曹腾 (name) + 养子 (“adopted son”).

issues.explanation: In 曹操字孟德, 字 introduces a courtesy name; it does not mean “letter.”
issues.suggested_fix: Gloss as “to have the courtesy name.”

issues.explanation: 孟德 is Cao Cao’s courtesy name and should be treated as a name, not an ordinary word.
issues.suggested_fix: Mark 孟德 as a name: “Mengde, Cao Cao’s courtesy name.”

issues.explanation: In 曾装病, 曾 means “once; formerly,” not surname Zeng.
In 以五色棒, 以 means “with/by means of,” not the unrelated Israel abbreviation.
左丰 is a personal name, but it is split into unrelated lexical segments.
issues.suggested_fix: Keep 左丰 together as the name Zuo Feng.

issues.explanation: In 刘备三人, 三 is the numeral “three,” not surname San.
In 因三人是白身, 三 is the numeral “three,” not surname San.
